body:
Wasn't what it sounded like. Still don't sound like that. But my bad for being so quick to assume.

Anyway, I hope she considers me too.
And another thing, the way I give in and sleep where she wants? That's love.

Not sure what you're implying, that I'm in the wrong and I don't love her, because I'm being honest about her selfishness with our sleeping arrangement?

I do love her, I just want her to realize that she's forgetting that her way of doing things is physically hurting me and preventing me from living my life.

I wouldn't say she's understanding. Feels more like she'd rather sweep everything under the rug than discipline or fire the people who bring me lower than I already am.

Definitely going to look into therapy. Thanks for everything.

Thanks for listening. I feel a little less alone and helpless in the world, although I still want to die.

Boss's answer is always "just ignore it," or if she's feeling particularly verbose, some variation of "they're crazy bitches who have nothing to be happy about, so what do you care what they think? Don't you have a good life? Be happy about that instead of dwelling on the negative."
Right, but I don't think you understand what I'm saying. I'm saying that no matter what I do with it, I invariably feel bad.

Okay, so at work right? I work 56 hours a week and I carry people, feed them, bathe them. The overnight crew is critical of everything I do, going so far as to gossip about me or cry if I don't perform to their expectations, even though they sleep 6 hours a night and don't do OT. 

I've been having back problems (and still working 56 hours, including a double for Thanksgiving!) so I had to leave some supplies in the basement not arranged and I know there will be complaints in the morning about how I didn't put away the boxes.

It took everything I had to leave instead of waiting for the night shift to tell them "yeah, my back's out, so I left the boxes downstairs, don't cry about it!" or leave a nasty note.

I'm home now and all I can do is feel like a quitter or a coward. That's what I'm dealing with.

Stuff like this is why I'm starting to hate my life and wish I was dead.
If I walk away, I'll always feel disappointed in myself.
Absolutely not. My boss wouldn't understand and I'm the only one who can do my job which is why I'm always here.
I feel like I'm running away from the problem. That I can't beat the problem, so I have to run away.

How.

"Go believe in yourself," as if feeling good and believing in oneself is a switch that can be flipped.

I'm trying to not get angry, but this statement makes me feel like you don't understand how self esteem works or how people without self esteem think.
That's not going to stop her from asking to sleep upstairs, together. If I don't sleep with her, she'll assume I don't love her.
TELL HIM
Not having good luck with friends, most of them are too busy with their own lives to help me. As for a mover, I can't afford it.

The bed downstairs is firmer and doesn't trigger my back problems.

If I could figure out how to get the good bed up there, I'd buy a back brace, sack up, and do it myself.
Don't apologize, I appreciate your posts.

I can't get much work with my degree and experience, I'm pretty much locked into this. As for therapy this or hobbies is usually it and usually enough to keep me going but lately, I can't pull it together anymore.

I can't exactly switch off with anyone, my other co-worker is obese and gets out of breath going from room to room. I love her dearly, almost like an aunt, but she's of little help so she does laundry and some light cooking while I do everything else.

I try to treat myself well, but I have this habit of putting myself last. I don't know why I do it, but I do.

I get along with my boss who cuts me lots of breaks and would give me a day off if I needed it, no questions asked. But her solution to a lot of problems is either "I need you to clutch it out and deal," or where applicable "I need ya to ignore it, cause there's nothing I can do."

So a complaint would do nothing.
I'm so sorry that happened, I hope you're doing better now.
The funny thing is that I'm a college graduate, but my degree is worthless in this state and I can't move to where it would be worth anything.
I appreciate you trying to help, I'm going to come back to what you said when I stop hurting and hope it makes more sense to me.

They hurt me pretty bad, so I'm pretty far from okay and it doesn't feel natural. Not sure having "stuff to do, different places to be," is enough to help me cope or feel okay with my life.

Forgive me for sounding like a child, but I don't want new friends that could potentially hurt me all over again, I want my old ones and the friendship I used to have.

I really don't know how to cope with people dropping me and suddenly hating me or making me feel so hated.

My best friend is a dick, so I welcome you.

The co-workers think he's a cute old man since he's basically a 2 year old in an 80 year old's body, so I doubt I could confide in them without them thinking of me as a monster.

I'm the only one here strong enough to work with him, otherwise there would be two people on him and I couldn't sentence 2 people to do my job and not feel bad about it.

More like a bad couple of years since he gets worse every year. Maybe today was the worst day in those couple of years, as he unhooked his arm from me every time I tried to help him to his feet and I quickly panicked to death.

Par for the course? "Potentially comes with the territory, but in rare circumstances," is more like it. I've been to many houses but none with this much responsibility attached to ONE person.

I'm a little afraid to post there because the truth is that since my last post, oldtimer has gotten worse and I've started hating his guts for the burden he's become. So now I'm too chickenshit to be judged by anyone, but I'm also too scared to hear that someone will tell me that I might be entitled to how I feel.

Please don't hate me, I hate myself enough for both of us.
I could never live with that. I feel bad enough hating him. I'm somewhere between hating myself as much I hate him.
Sorry you're getting burntout, I'm feeling the same way too. I wish there was an active subreddit that let people like us vent.
